title: Soul Sister Christmas 2026
seo_title: Soul Sister Christmas 2026 in Bolivar, MO
description: Soul Sister Christmas is an evening for ladies at The Hill Church with dinner, an encouraging word, giveaways, and time to connect with other women. Tickets are $15 per person, seating is limited so getting a ticket early is advised, and dressing up is welcome but not required. It takes place Sunday, December 13, 2026 at 6:00 PM at 2103 S Springfield Ave in Bolivar, MO.
